title: sigil-speech-text-sets/1
description: One JSON line of the text sets written by scripts/speech-bench/corpus/build_text_sets.py: MT sets (corpus/mt/<set>.jsonl, the mt-bench corpus format plus provenance; mt-bench ignores the extra fields) and TTS prompts (corpus/tts/prompts.jsonl). Validate a line against #/$defs/mt_line or #/$defs/tts_prompt.

domain.description: WMT24++ domain (social, speech, news, literary), BSD scene, FLORES topic.

doc.description: Document / dialogue id (the previous line of the same doc is the context).

kind.description: casual: stream / VRChat-style lines; read: FLEURS read sentences; long: multi-sentence (TTFA and stability); numbers: digits, dates, units.

voice.description: Preset voice override for every engine (normally per engine in the spec).

reference_voice.description: Voice-library id of a reference clip for cloning engines.
